headline: Indian IT services showed mixed growth, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while profit momentum slowed for some.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest (Infosys 1.5%) to very high (Coforge 53.6%). AI contributed to profit lifts at HCLTech and deal wins at Infosys and TCS. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and newly introduced by HCLTech and Wipro. Profit growth was uneven, with Wipro and Infosys seeing the weakest increases.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI as a growth driver, with HCLTech reporting $219 m AI revenue and Infosys noting a 29% AI revenue rise.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins fell or stayed flat for many mid‑tier players, while only a few maintained high margins.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY, the fastest in the sector.
Revenue up 11.5% YoY with 21% profit jump, strong AI contribution.
Consistent double‑digit revenue growth (11.2% YoY) and high operating margin (24%).

laggards.why: Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and margin slipped to 16.5%.
Revenue growth only 1.5% YoY and profit growth slowed to 6%.
Revenue growth modest at 7% YoY and profit growth, while margin unusually high but volatile.
